title.en: Fable 26 — The Boy Who Cried Wolf

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.ar: ילד שמר על כבשים על הגבעה.
sentences.en: A boy guarded sheep on the hill.

sentences.ar: הוא ישב שם לבד כל היום.
sentences.en: He sat there alone all day.
The sheep ate grass quietly.
The boy was very bored.

sentences.ar: יום אחד הוא חשב על משחק.
sentences.en: One day he thought of a game.
He stood and shouted: wolf!
Wolf!
All the village people left everything.

sentences.ar: הם רצו במעלה הגבעה עם מקלות.
sentences.en: They ran up the hill with sticks.

sentences.ar: הילד צחק ואמר: לא היה זאב.
sentences.en: The boy laughed and said: there was no wolf.

sentences.ar: אחרי שבוע הוא עשה את זה שוב.
sentences.en: After a week he did it again.
The people came again, and ran fast.

sentences.ar: הילד צחק חזק יותר מאשר בפעם הראשונה.
sentences.en: The boy laughed harder than the first time.
They went and were very angry at him.
One evening a real wolf came.
It went in among the sheep slowly.
The boy shouted: wolf!
Come quickly!
The people in the village heard him.

sentences.ar: הם אמרו: זה המשחק שלו שוב.
sentences.en: They said: it is his game again.
No one went up to the hill.

sentences.ar: מי ששיקר פעמיים לא מקבל אמון.
sentences.en: Whoever has lied twice does not receive trust.
